themes.title: House Lights
themes.author: Dark Magic Studios
themes.readme:
# House Lights

A dark arena wash in cyan and magenta. Import it from Settings → Theme. It becomes your Custom theme.

No photographs. The colours are the whole look.

databases.title: Harbor Circuit
databases.author: Dark Magic Studios
databases.readme:
# Harbor Circuit

A one-promotion starter database. Harbor City Wrestling and Lane Porter are fictional.

Import the `.bbdb` in DataStudio. This file has no images. If you add portraits later, host them yourself and name the host in this README.
